limits: Nine published responses: eight clearly external and one DGUV response with external-boundary eligibility still pending. No national denominator.
All 39 physical response pages received full independent initial and peer reads. Target dates, publication dates and recipient delivery remain distinct.

The current official draft has October technical metadata; exact August dispatch, synopsis and reading-version bytes were not recovered. Later matching content corroborates but does not certify historical wording.
Current-law, EU and conditional technical premises are distinguished from full historical-draft compound claims. Unresolved does not establish error.
Long background statutes and studies were read in relevant passages; root separately reread all 15 pages of the short current draft for final comparison.
No author contact, human specialist confirmation or intent inference. Rechecking adds zero reading units.
conclusions: No new error finding admitted. Existing DGAUM bibliography findings are not counted again.
Every initial claim received independent full-context peer review; every peer challenge and omission has a separate root resolution.

The post-COVID latency hypothesis remains unresolved after two independent contextual reviews and root review. WHO diagnostic timing is not a universal latest-onset bound, and the grouped author example has a reasonable alternative reading.
